notes: If FleetComm cannot update itself from where it's running, it now says so instead of failing silently. Updating works by replacing the exe file in place, and Windows forbids that inside protected folders — an exe parked in C:\Program Files failed every update attempt since v0.11 without a word of explanation. FleetComm now checks the folder before downloading anything and tells you plainly to move the exe somewhere normal (Desktop, Documents, your own folder — a portable app doesn't belong in Program Files). Two more updater hardenings from the same investigation: everything the install script prints is now captured to a log file, so a failed install can always explain itself afterwards; and a bookkeeping file the updater writes was in a format Windows PowerShell corrupts slightly, which could quietly break the rule that a failed update is only retried automatically once — fixed.
